items.summary: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
items.recommend_reason_zh: Dageno AI 2.0 能帮你看清 AI 为何推荐竞争对手而不是你，值得打开一探背后的原因。
items.recommend_reason_en: Dageno AI 2.0 helps you see why AI recommends your competitors instead of you, making it worth opening to understand those AI-driven recommendations.

items.summary: One URL for every MCP server.
items.recommend_reason_zh: MCP1 为每个 MCP 服务器提供一个统一 URL，方便访问和接入，值得打开了解它如何简化服务器连接。
items.recommend_reason_en: MCP1 provides one URL for every MCP server, making it worth opening when you need a single place to find the URL for a given MCP server.

items.summary: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans
items.recommend_reason_zh: Pawse.ai 的声音是按狗狗的听觉设计的，而不是迎合人类耳朵；如果你想让爱犬体验专属音频，可以打开看看。
items.recommend_reason_en: Pawse.ai offers sound engineered for dogs rather than humans, making it worth opening if you want to explore audio designed around canine ears instead of people.

items.summary: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in
items.recommend_reason_zh: Watchflows 把 AI 内置到 Mac 的可视化自动化中，适合想直观搭建工作流的人打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Watchflows offers visual automation for your Mac with AI built in, making it worth opening if you want to explore automating tasks through a visual interface.
